logic.case: mushroom tapped (coil loop broken for 0.5 ms) while armed
logic.detail: LATCH False, K1 open

logic.case: AUX wire breaks while running
logic.detail: no FORCE (U6 is held cleared: K2_DRIVE = LATCH ∧ ¬AUX goes high and K2 re-closes), K1 stays closed on PRE_OK: a latent fault; the next stop gets **no forced discharge** (≈ 300 ms of bus on the drives' idle draw). Only the Pi sees it (AUX_OK low → supervisor e-stop latch)

logic.case: AUX stuck closed, then ARM
logic.detail: K1 closes on an empty bus (pre-charge bypassed: Q4 holds on AUX, K2_DRIVE = ¬AUX is off), bus 0.0 V at closing → inrush limited only by ESR / wiring; and no aux edge at the next stop, so no FORCE

logic.case: K1 main contacts welded, heartbeat stops
logic.detail: no aux edge → no FORCE; the bus stays powered from the supply; only the Pi (DISABLE frames) and the drives' CAN timeout remain

logic.case: 12 V gate-driver supply lost (U2 / F2) while running
logic.detail: the comparator still switches but UCC27524 has no supply: no clamp, no FORCE, and K1 stays closed. Regen then charges the bus without limit (M1 1.3 kW into 7 mF: 25 → 28 V in ≈ 0 ms)

logic.case: heartbeat stops while running

logic.case: ARM with a mushroom pressed / without heartbeat
logic.detail: LATCH False / False

logic.case: logic supply lost and restored (PSU trip, brownout)
logic.detail: after power returns: LATCH False, K1 open (power-on reset)

logic.case: mushroom tapped (coil loop broken for 0.5 ms) while armed
logic.detail: LATCH False, K1 open

logic.case: AUX wire breaks while running
logic.detail: discrepancy → FORCE at +30 ms and LATCH cleared, K1 open at +40 ms (the clamp loads the supply for the release time: the bench supply may latch); stop, fail-safe

logic.case: AUX stuck closed, then ARM
logic.detail: ARM refused (¬AUX on the ARM condition)

logic.case: K1 main contacts welded, heartbeat stops
logic.detail: FORCE 53 ms after the last edge: the clamp loads the supply at 135 A → the bench supply latches off (≥ 43.8 A); on the robot the pack keeps the bus up: needs a second break (BMS discharge FET off)

logic.case: 12 V gate-driver supply lost (U2 / F2) while running
logic.detail: 12 V UVLO → STOP: K1 opens, LATCH cleared (the bus then has no clamp: the 1 kΩ bleeder and the SMDJ33A only)

logic.case: mushroom pressed while running (base channel)
logic.detail: K1 open at +10 ms (arm category 0); the base switch stays on through the ramp and opens at +2.000 s (U20 OFF-delay 2.0 s); FORCE_B fires

logic.case: base heartbeat stops while running (arm loop alive)
logic.detail: WD_B low → STOP: K1 open at +33 ms, base switch off at +2.023 s (the drives' CAN timeout ramps the base meanwhile)

logic.case: heartbeats return during the SS1 delay
logic.detail: base switch off at +2.023 s anyway, K1 open, LATCH False: only ARM re-energises U20

logic.case: ARM without the base heartbeat
logic.detail: LATCH False

logic.case: Q9 (base switch) shorted, mushroom pressed
logic.detail: enable off at +2.000 s but the base bus stays: DISC_B at +2.050 s → GPIO + the BMS discharge FET off over CAN (second break, as for a welded K1); the drives are already disabled / quick-stopped
